title: Desperate Times
start: Talk to Seren, up the stairs in Burthorpe castle.

items.t: The stone spirits must not be in an ore box. They must be in the backpack.
Old necklace or necklace of Charos (obtainable during the quest)
Any set of equipment that allows access to the Black Knights' Fortress or a Skull of Remembrance for teleporting directly inside

recommended.t: Portable fairy ring, TokKul-Zo for the close proximity to a fairy ring or grace of the elves attuned to the fairy ring
Dig Site pendant or Archaeology journal for quick access to the Varrock Dig Site
Two Phoenix Lair Teleports or memory strands to get back to the needle

kills.t: Ability to defeat five level 50 opponents

steps.t: Talk to Seren on the floor 2 of Burthorpe Castle. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Osman for a location. (north-east of the table next to Garlandia) [Chat: 1 Do you have anywhere we could plant the garden?]
Talk to Sir Amik Varze for a workforce. (Directly north of the table) [Chat: 2 Do you have a workforce to plant it?]
Talk to Azzanadra for seeds. (North-west of the table, next to Commander Zilyana) [Chat: 1 Desperate Times › 3 Do you have any seeds we could use? › 1 Yes]
Talk to Vanescula Drakan for a location. (By the staircase) [Chat: 1 Do you have anywhere we could plant the garden? › 1 Change to Morytania. › 1 Yes.]
Talk to Zarador for a location. (South-western corner of the room) [Chat: 1 Do you have anywhere we could plant the garden? › 1 Change to Feldip. › 1 Yes]
Kerapac will appear. Complete the dialogue and proceed to The Needle.

sub.t: If the dialogue containing Kerapac does not start, talk to Seren. [Chat: ~]

steps.t: Travel to the Needle and talk to Kerapac. [Chat: 3 Let's get on with it. › 3 Say nothing. › 1 Yes, I'm ready.]

sub.t: It is located west of Piscatoris Fishing Colony (Phoenix Lair Teleport, fairy ring AKQ, Sixth-Age circuit teleports to Guthix memorial, or via memory strands within the currency pouch).

steps.t: Close the 5 temporal instabilities

sub.t: 2 on the path from the needle to the house.
1 inside the courtyard of the house.

steps.t: Talk to Kerapac again.
Go inside McGrubor's Wood. Descend into the mysterious hole just south of the house. [Chat: 1 Yes]

sub.t: Navigate to using fairy ring ALS or the Seers' Village lodestone and go west around the fence to enter McGrubor's Wood.

steps.t: Run through and investigate the coffin.
Read the letter from Charos.
Go to the Varrock Dig Site and step on the strange portal near the entrance to the Empty Throne Room. It is found north of the screening station.
Enter the Black Knights' Fortress, and step on the portal on the floor 1 of the Black Knights' Fortress in the south-east room near the entrance to the fortress.
Follow the key rules above again.
Step on the exit portal to the west.
Step on the portal in the south-east room on the floor 2 of Varrock Palace. The portal is hidden behind the eastern bath screen. King Roald and Sir Amik Varze will be at the table near the stairs.
Follow the key rules above for this part.
Step on the exit portal to the west.
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library (the northern-most room of the floor 1 of the palace) [Chat: 1 [Use Charos's Necklace.] › Any › Any › Any]
Give Charos 3 rune bars, 2 runite stone spirits, 10 gleaming energy, and 10 mind runes.

sub.t: Runite stone spirits in an ore box will not work. They must be in the backpack.

steps.t: Gear for combat. Deaths here are non-safe.
p: Final room map, wisps in red

steps.t: Return to The Needle. (Phoenix Lair Teleport, fairy ring AKQ, Sixth-Age circuit teleports to Guthix memorial, or via memory strands within the currency pouch)
Talk to Kerapac.
Manoeuver through the paths and kill the 5 Sliske clones, pick up the fragments. Make sure lootshare is turned off.

sub.t: The Sliske clones appear to spawn from stepping on specific spots, so if the clones don't spawn step through each path comprehensively until they spawn

p: Kerapac and Thok at the Needle

steps.t: Combine the fragments into Sliske's mask.
Walk to the bottom of the platform, wear the mask, and kill Guthix. [Chat: 1 Yes - Kill him]
Harvest the five memories on Naragun, each memory shows up as a yellow dot on the minimap, and go through the dialogue until the NPCs teleport away.
Talk to Guthix near the empty fairy ring. [Chat: Any]
Click each mutable anima once so both the green particles will end up on Kerapac. There are 4 in total.
Go into the room to the west, jump the gap outside the window on the south-east side, run across the planks, drop down the rock face, climb the rock face, and climb through the obstacle.
Run around through each room and open the door at the last room.
Switch all the green mutable anima.

sub.t: Use temporal rifts to teleport between levels. There are 3 levels in total with the bottom and top floors containing 1 mutable anima each and the middle floor containing 2.

steps.t: Redirect the green mutable anima to Kerapac (refer to the image).

sub.t: Harvest all three unrefined anima (red dots on the image) to unlock the three frozen anima. Make sure to finish the dialogue with each NPC.
Switch the green mutable anima according to the direction on the image. All of these can be clicked while standing on the main floor.
Disable bloom in graphics settings if it is difficult to see the direction the green mutable anima is facing.

p: Example of a word grid to solve sliding puzzle after unlocking all the chests

steps.t: After a cutscene, return to the Council of Burthorpe and talk to Seren. (If cutscene doesn't start, talk to Kerapac.)
p: An avatar of Kerapac discusses his plans.
The first anima puzzle, as Saradomin and Zamorak fight in Guthix's chambers
One of the three portals, in the Black Knights' Fortress
